notes:
Topline: Mid-market B2B collaboration SaaS evaluating Redwood for chat + search/rerank workflow. Started on Hosted API for quick prototyping; successful integrations for 2 internal apps. Moving to Dedicated POC to validate sustained QPS and meet data residency/KMS needs.

Key requirements:
- Workloads: chat (context windows ~4k tokens), semantic search + reranking for document discovery, async summarization.
- Latency: target p50 < 90ms for small chat replies; p99 target < 350ms for interactive routes; rerank batch throughput target 400 qps during batch windows.
- Cost sensitivity: want clear unit economics; target < $0.015/token equivalent across production mix.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logs, KMS integration, EU data residency for subset of customers.
- Model preferences: prefer open model families; willing to evaluate Redwood-verified quantized variants for cost. Need routing to fall back to smaller model variant under load.

POC scope (agreed):
1) 4-week Dedicated POC in us-east with a canary: route 10% of production traffic for week 1, evaluate metrics, then 25% week 2, full ramp week 3 if SLOs met.
2) Canary plan includes: health checks, automatic rollback threshold (error rate > 2% or p99 latency increase > 40%), manual gate for expansion.
3) Fallback routing plan: primary -> dedicated large-quantized model (gpt-style open), fallback -> smaller quantized variant in same region, secondary fallback -> hosted API in eu-west for disaster/regional outage.
4) Rollback playbook documented and validated: automated routing switch + traffic drain + alerting to on-call.

Quotes / notes from calls: "We need predictable latency when externalizing the assistant to customers." — Head of Product. "If the dedicated pricing doesn't clear, we can stay on Hosted with caching for now." — CTO.

Security review status: Initial questionnaire returned 2026-02-20; SE + security sync held 2026-02-25. Legal requested DPA edits; tracker RL-1150.

POC success criteria:
- Meet latency SLOs for canary 10% traffic for five consecutive days.
- No data leakage observed in audit logs; KMS integration completes.
- Cost per unit within 20% of target.

Next deliverables: Redwood to provide Dedicated POC runbook, pricing for 3-month pilot, and canary routing config template by 2026-03-03.
